description: List study plans and articles for a subject or topic. Pass a subject code from list_subjects (for example "parsha", "holidays", "tehillim", "stories"), or any topic tag (for example "jonah", "purim", "psalm 23"). Results are paginated; pass the returned cursor to get more.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor returned by a previous browse_subject call.

subject.description: Subject code from list_subjects, or any topic tag.

name: browse_subject
title: Browse a subject
